# TWM Advisory
> Operating Performance Partner — Forward Deployed Engineer posture.

Site: https://www.twm.expert
Contact: tannous@twm.expert
Founder: Tannous Mekari (Président, TWM ADVISORY — SIREN 106 067 549)

## Positioning
TWM Advisory is an Operating Performance Partner. Engagements are run in a Forward Deployed Engineer posture: embedded with client teams, from diagnosis through execution and measurement — not remote slide decks.

## What we do
TWM helps leadership and shareholders improve operating and commercial performance:
1. Cut avoidable costs (tools, rework, redundant spend)
2. Free and redeploy capacity
3. Protect margin (billing, pricing, cost-to-serve)
4. Turn partner networks into growth systems (Partner Performance)
5. Equip teams with context, steering and product-builder capability (Performance OS)

## How we work
- Start from an economic priority, not a fixed tech brief
- Embed with teams (Forward Deployed)
- Choose means after diagnosis (ops, partners, commerce, software/AI)
- Measure gains with finance before claiming results
- Remuneration can combine fixed fees and gain-share when attribution is robust
